text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""GATE"—the Tenno Sho (Spring).
The greatest hurdle—I've always aimed for."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After this day, Neo Universe might disappear.
Believing that, I had prepared for the worst.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For the Neo Universe of another universe, it wasn't during the race, but somewhere "between after the race and summer" that she suffered a major setback.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then this Tenno Sho (Spring) is a false gate. There is no need to avoid it—nor should you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "Great King" and the "Singularity" will come.
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san...
Once again, I'm in your care.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I was the one doing the chasing.
But this year...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, Neo Universe
always wants to "stay close."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The future is still—coexisting.
Possible, and impossible..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""NIZR" won't be... repeated.
I don't want to repeat it. But—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even if it's impossible—I want to 'leave it behind'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In another universe, this race was our final showdown.
I have no idea what will happen in this universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... there was no guarantee that nothing would happen.
I decided to stay vigilant until the end and watch over the clash between the two.
